name: Kimlynn Temple
title: CEO
bio:
Kimlynn is the founder of tipped, a digital tipping platform that has grown into a movement for economic inclusion, helping workers in the informal economy earn recognition, stability, and dignity. In 2024, tipped was rolled out nationwide in partnership with Sasol.
She believes technology should be a force for good: bridging gaps, solving everyday challenges, and creating opportunities where none existed before. A developer, QA specialist, and UX designer, she is drawn to the intersection of psychology and design, and to turning overlooked inefficiencies into solutions that empower people.
